candidate_workaround: Accumulate each term result in an explicit array and pipe that completed array to JSON conversion after the loop.
failure_signature: PowerShell rejected a direct pipeline following a foreach statement block with an empty-pipe-element parser error.
recurrence_guard: When a PowerShell foreach statement produces structured rows, assign those rows to an array before applying a downstream pipeline.
rollback: Give the rejected wrapper zero novelty-audit credit and leave the repository source state unchanged.

title: Materialize PowerShell foreach results before downstream conversion
trigger_preconditions: A PowerShell statement-level foreach block is followed by a pipeline in the same expression.
